I would love to have you draw a girl with short hair with a background.
The costume should be a cute, girlish outfit in the story modern style.
The eyes should be a shiny blue or red color. The bangs should be brownish (even if it's brighter) rather than blunt. The length should be about to hit or miss your shoulder.
A breeze or other nodding would be great!
I'll need a background that looks good on a girl, and I'll leave it up to you.
